objective: Test whether the already-frozen V6A positive signed-gap signal has economically positive same-day short-side value after 09:35 under a fixed index-level research proxy.

execution.position_rule: enter one-unit short iff frozen signed-gap prediction > 0; else flat

comparators.V5A_mapped_strategy: same zero-threshold short-only 09:35-to-15:00 rule with identical costs
comparators.always_short: short every eligible day from 09:35 to 15:00 with identical costs

decision_semantics.DEV_PASS: all frozen sample and economic gates pass; a separate 2021-2025 reusable BLACKBOX protocol may then be written without changing this strategy identity
decision_semantics.DEV_CLOSE: sample is sufficient but one or more frozen economic gates fail; do not rescue this identity by changing threshold, time, costs, side, exit, sizing, stop/target or predictor
decision_semantics.DEV_INSUFFICIENT: the frozen 2019-2020 execution sample cannot satisfy preregistered sufficiency without changing the identity

hard_constraints: no 2021-2025 strategy outcome access before DEV_PASS
no entry or exit time search
no predictor retraining or feature changes
